en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a European town square with a large ornate fountain in the center and a historic building behind it. The fountain has multiple statues, including a standing figure elevated on a column and several figures around the basin, with curved water spouts or arches. The adjoining building has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, an arcaded ground floor with stone columns, and a long wooden balcony on the upper floor. A man is visible in the foreground pulling a two-wheeled handcart across the square. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
